channel.title: The Minnesota Star Tribune - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Minnesota Star Tribune (startribune.com)

item.title: Angie Craig says she regrets past immigration vote in wake of Operation Metro Surge
item.description: Craig said in an op-ed that Trump’s immigration crackdown on Minnesota made her “question whether I made the right call last year.”

item.title: Minnesota autism center owner pleads guilty in massive social services fraud
item.description: Prosecutors allege Star Autism Center in St. Cloud bilked the state and a health insurer out of $6 million.

item.title: Quinn Hughes appears on ‘The Tonight Show’
item.description: Wild superstar Quinn Hughes is winding down his media tour after Monday night’s appearance with Jimmy Fallon.

item.title: Woman accused of making numerous threats to harm Minnesota House Speaker Lisa Demuth
item.description: The charge comes fewer than 9 months after the assassination of DFL state Rep. Melissa Hortman.

item.title: Minnesota sues Trump administration over frozen Medicaid payments
item.description: The federal government is attempting to withhold more than a quarter of a billion dollars in Medicaid funding with officials pointing to Minnesota’s handling of fraud.

item.title: Mayor Jacob Frey moves after buying house in southwest Minneapolis
item.description: Frey and his wife, Sarah Clarke, have said they would likely move to a house after having their second child.

item.title: Trump pushes back on mounting criticism about his Iran war battle plan as conflict spreads
item.description: President Donald Trump on Monday pushed back against mounting criticism that he hasn't done enough to explain why it was necessary to start a war with Iran now or to articulate his vision for an endgame to the escalating conflict.

item.title: Sheriff’s Office investigating incident during arrest of demonstrators at Whipple Building
item.description: The Hennepin County Sheriff’s Office said deputies declared an unlawful assembly.

item.title: Greg Bovino, other federal agents investigated for Operation Metro Surge actions
item.description: Hennepin County Attorney Mary Moriarty said her office is already investigating 17 incidents involving potential unlawful conduct by federal agents.

item.title: Judge orders MN’s U.S. Attorney to appear at contempt hearing Tuesday over violations in immigration cases
item.description: The judge said he called the hearing for the U.S. government to explain why they shouldn’t be held in contempt
